workspaceChanged: The workspace or record changed. Reopen evidence.
figureJobHelp: Your inputs and earlier figures stay intact. The complete calculation is saved as a new revision. Retry restarts the same calculation.
datasetJobHelp: Your original stays intact. Preparation retains bounded pages, then saves the complete dataset revision. Retry restarts parsing and reuses identical retained pages.
retryWhenResolved: Retry when the problem is resolved.
originalsRetained: Originals and earlier revisions are retained.
uploadRetry: Uploaded bytes are retained; retry when ready.
savingPaused: Saving paused. Received references are retained.
replaceFigureConfirm: Replace this record figure with the retained calculation? Earlier analysis revisions remain available.
figureAdded: Figure added to the draft. Review and save the record.
pauseImport: Pause or finish the import before leaving.
currentUnavailable: The current record is unavailable. The retained revision remains readable.
saveBeforeEvidence: Save the record before opening evidence and analysis.
runChanged: The workspace or record changed. Reopen the run.
newRun: New run draft. Record deliberate changes and deviations separately.
discardSelectionConfirm: Discard this unfinished selection? Retained records and original files remain available.
distinctExclusion: Choose a distinct acquisition row and explain its exclusion.
verifying: Verifying retained revisions and original bytes…
figureEdited: The record figure was edited after calculation. The retained result is unchanged.
noAssociatedEvidence: No evidence is associated with this record.
noEvidence: No evidence yet. Import an original file, then retain a dataset or document an analysis.
evidenceChanged: Evidence changed since this list was opened. Return to latest evidence to refresh.
completeSelection: Complete this selection to attach it to the record.
referenceBatches: Exact references are saved in batches. Received references survive interruption; the complete selection is attached together.
selectionRetryHelp: The selection remains in this dialog. Retry saving to check which references were received.
hashHelp: A hash identifies bytes; it does not establish accuracy or authorship. Use Storage & access to create a verified backup, then verify evidence after restoration.
datasetHelp: The original stays intact. Choose how its values become columns; numerical meaning can be declared in the retained dataset.
rootArrayHelp: Leave blank for an array at the root of the file.
jsonMappingHelp: Map columns using JSON Pointer paths relative to each row, such as /counter or /measurement/value. Leave a field path blank for a scalar row. Numbers retain their exact spelling. Unmapped fields remain in the original.
structuredValuesHelp: Object and array values stay intact and can be opened in the value inspector.
presenceHelp: [null] means a declared JSON null; [absent] means the field was missing.
schemaHelp: Saving creates a revision. Earlier analyses keep their original inputs. Values are never rewritten.
exclusionsHelp: Exclusions on this page only. Row numbers refer to this page; other pages keep their exclusions. Original values remain available.
figureHelp: Declare numeric columns in “Edit schema & exclusions” first. Count rows also works with text categories. Calculations read retained pages. Figures keep the complete retained result; the reader displays a selected range and exports the complete figure.
homeRecord: {title} · Imports and revisions are saved when you confirm each action.
backgroundWork: Work continues while this workspace is unlocked. You can close this dialog and return from Evidence & analysis.
remainingHelp: {count} {slot} still needed for {title}. Select revisions that have not already been received.
selectionChanged: This selection changed. Reopen the unfinished {kind}.
completionUnconfirmed: Completion could not be confirmed. Retry to check the saved result. {message}
datasetRows: {rows} original rows · Page {page} of {pages}. Original values retain their spelling. Expand a row number for its identity.
plotSource: Source revision {revision}. Plot coordinates are approximate decimal values; exact source values remain in the dataset. Explicit-base integers can be labels.
mappingPreviewHelp: First {rows} rows and {columns} of {total} columns. The complete file is validated when preparing the dataset.
readEvidenceHelp: Read original files, datasets and retained analyses associated with this record.
privateEvidenceHelp: Original files, datasets and analysis revisions stay private. Figures added to the record follow its sharing setting.
